name: Beer, high alcohol (5% v/v & above)
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using warm temperature fermentation. Alcohol content greater than or equal to 5% v/v.

name: Beer, full strength (alcohol 4-4.9% v/v)
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), using low fermentation temperatures. Alcohol content between 4-4.9% v/v.

name: Beer, full strength (alcohol 4-4.9% v/v), low carbohydrate
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), resulting in lower final carbohydrate levels than regular beer. Alcohol content between 4-4.9% v/v.

name: Beer, full strength (alcohol 4-4.9% v/v), gluten free
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of gluten free grains, resulting in lower final carbohydrate levels than regular beer and no gluten. Alcohol content between 4-4.9% v/v.

name: Beer, home-brewed, full strength
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared in the home and characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley). Alcohol content approximately 4% v/v.

name: Beer, mid-strength (alcohol 3-3.9% v/v)
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as mid or mid-strength. Alcohol content between 3-3.9% v/v.

name: Beer, light (alcohol 1- <2.9% v/v)
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), so as to restrict alcohol formation or to remove alcohol after fermentation. Products are described on label as Light or Lite. Alcohol content between 1-2.9% v/v.

name: Beer, home-brewed, reduced alcohol, light beer, or mid-strength
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared in the home and characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley), and with a lower alcohol content than usual. Alcohol content approximately 2% v/v.

name: Beer, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley). Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Beer, not further defined
notes: Alcoholic beverage characterised by the presence of hops or preparations of hops, prepared by the yeast fermentation of an aqueous extract of malted or unmalted cereals (usually barley). Includes all beers, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Bitters
notes: A high-alcohol spirit containing spices and flavours such as gentian, and sugar. Typically added to beverages in small amounts.

name: Cider, apple, alcoholic
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented apples with significant residual sugars. Alcohol content approximately 4% v/v.

name: Cider, apple, alcoholic, low carbohydrate
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented apples, formulated to contain less carbohydrates. Alcohol content approximately 4% v/v.

name: Cider, apple, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented apples with significant residual sugars. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Cider, pear (perry), alcoholic
notes: Alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented pears with significant residual sugars. Alcohol content approximately 4% v/v.

name: Cider, not further defined
notes: Alcoholic cider made from fermented fruit, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Liqueur, cream based
notes: Flavoured alcoholic beverage mixed with dairy cream. Alcohol content approximately 14% v/v.

name: Liqueur, non cream based
notes: Alcoholic beverage containing spirits with flavourings and other ingredients. Alcohol content approximately 25% v/v.

name: Mirin
notes: Commercially prepared rice based sweet cooking wine, commonly used in Japanese style cooking. Alcohol content approximately 14% v/v.

name: Port
notes: Sweet, alcoholic beverage prepared from fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Alcohol content approximately 16% v/v.

name: Sake
notes: Alcoholic beverage derived from fermenting rice that has been polished to remove the bran. Also referred to as Japanese rice wine. Alcohol content approximately 14% v/v.

name: Sherry
notes: Fermented grape juice to which additional alcohol is added. Alcohol content approximately 14% v/v.

name: Spirit, all types
notes: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products. Alcohol content approximately 40% v/v.

name: Spirit, all types, cooked
notes: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of wine or fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products. Heated until a large proportion of alcohol has evaporated.

name: Spirit, all types, de-alcoholised
notes: Includes beverages obtained from the distillation of fermented sugar, cereals or potatoes, or the fermented preparation of grapes or grape products. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Wine, red
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour. Alcohol content approximately 12% v/v.

name: Wine, red, reduced alcohol
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour. Processed so that less alcohol remains than in regular red wine. Alcohol content less than 9% v/v.

name: Wine, red, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Wine, red, cooked
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour. Heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.

name: Wine, red, sparkling
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour, and retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Alcohol content approximately 12% v/v.

name: Wine, red, sparkling, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with prolonged contact with dark grape skins to produce wine of a deep red colour, and retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Wine, rose
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice with brief contact with dark grape skins to produce a wine of a pale pink colour. Alcohol content approximately 12% v/v.

name: Wine, white
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce a wine of a pale yellow colour. Alcohol content approximately 12% v/v.

name: Wine, white, reduced alcohol
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce a wine of a pale yellow colour, and processed so that less alcohol remains than in regular white wine. Alcohol content less than 9% v/v.

name: Wine, white, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce a wine of pale yellow colour. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Wine, white, cooked
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce a wine of pale yellow colour. Heated until the majority of alcohol has evaporated.

name: Wine, white, sparkling
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce wine of a pale yellow colour, and retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Alcohol content approximately 12% v/v.

name: Wine, white, sparkling, de-alcoholised
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce wine of a pale yellow colour, and retaining significant quantities of dissolved carbon dioxide. Processed to remove the majority of alcohol.

name: Wine, white, sweet dessert style
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced by fermentation of grape juice, typically prepared from pale-skinned grapes to produce wine of a pale yellow colour and a high level of residual sugars (approximately 10%). Alcohol content approximately 10% v/v.

name: Cocktail, cream or milk based
notes: Alcoholic beverage containing a combination of spirits and/or liqueurs mixed with ice, milk and/or cream.

name: Cocktail, fruit juice based
notes: Alcoholic beverage containing a combination of spirits and/or liqueurs mixed with syrup, ice and fruit juice.

name: Cocktail, soft drink based
notes: Alcoholic beverage containing a combination of spirits and/or liqueurs mixed with ice and soft drink.

name: Cocktail, ready to drink
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur, fruit juices and flavours. Available in a range of cocktail flavours.

name: Cocktail, ready to drink, coffee based
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing spirits and/or liqueur and coffee.

name: Cocktail, ready to drink, de-alcoholised
notes: Pre-mixed beverage containing de-alcoholised spirits and/or liqueur, carbonated water, fruit juice extracts and flavours. Available in a range of cocktail flavours.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & cola soft drink
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and cola flavoured soft drink. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & non-cola soft drink
notes: Alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and non-cola flavoured soft drink. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, commercial, pre-mixed, spirit & energy drink
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and energy drink. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & juice
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and fruit juice. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & soda
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and soda water. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & tonic
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and regular tonic water. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & soft drink, de-alcoholised
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a non-alcoholic spirit and/or liqueur and soft drink.

name: Mixed drink, ready to drink, spirit & diet soft drink
notes: Pre-mixed alcoholic beverage containing a spirit and/or liqueur and diet soft drink. Approximately 5% v/v alcohol.

name: Mulled wine
notes: Alcoholic beverage made with red wine, spices and fruit. Served warm.

name: Wine cooler, wine & fruit juice blend, all flavours
notes: Alcoholic beverage produced from a mixture of white wine and fruit juice, sometimes with added flavouring. Approximately 4% v/v alcohol.

name: Beverage base, drinking chocolate
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured begerage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, cocoa or chocolate, maltodextrin, milk solids, soy lecithin, salt or flavour. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Beverage base, drinking chocolate, intense sweetened
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured begerage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include cocoa or chocolate, intense sweeteners, milk solids, soy lecithin or salt. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Milo)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids, sugar and cocoa. Contains added iron, calcium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids and cocoa. May contain added vitamins (A, B1, B2, B3, B6, B12, C, D, E) and minerals (Ca, Fe, Mg).

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Milo), reduced sugar
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids, cocoa and intense sweetener. Contains added iron, calcium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D. Formulated to be lower in sugar than regular Milo. Milo 30% less added sugar is an example of this product.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Milo plant based)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk or dairy alternative. Typical ingredients include malted cereals (barley or rice), cocoa and soy protein isolate. Contains added iron, calcium, zinc and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C and D.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, unfortified (Nesquik brand)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, cocoa, soy lecithin and salt. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Ovaltine)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include barley and malt extract, milk solids, sugar and cocoa. Contains added iron, calcium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, intense sweetened, unfortified (Ovaltine Light Break)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of hot water. Typical ingredients include milk solids, barley and malt extract, glucose solids, cocoa and intense sweetener. Does not contain added vitamins and minerals.

name: Beverage base, chocolate flavour, added vitamins & minerals (Aktavite)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include wheat starch, sugar, cocoa and malt. Contains added vitamins (A, B1, B2, B3, B6, B12, C, D3, E & folate) and minerals (Ca, I, Mg, Fe, K, P, Zn).

name: Beverage base, non-chocolate flavours, unfortified (Nesquik brand)
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a non-chocolate flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, flavours, soy lecithin and salt. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Beverage base, flavoured, from drinking straw, containing added sugar & intense sweetener, unfortified
notes: Dry beverage base packed into a straw and used to prepare a flavoured beverage when used to sip milk. Typical ingredients include sugar, tapioca or corn starch, maltodextrin, flavour and/or cocoa powder, intense sweetener and colour. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Beverage base, malted milk powder
notes: Dry beverage base used to prepare a malt flavoured beverage with the addition of milk. Typical ingredients include malted cereals, milk solids, maltodextrin, vegetable oil and soy lecithin. Contains added calcium and vitamins A, B1, B2, D. May contain added iron and vitamin B1.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with cocoa powder & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from dry cocoa powder to which cow's milk is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with drinking chocolate & water
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing drinking chocolate powder with hot water.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with drinking chocolate & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from dry drinking chocolate to which cow's milk is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with drinking chocolate & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from drinking chocolate powder to which a dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with Milo powder & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from dry Milo powder to which cow's milk is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with Milo powder & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from dry Milo powder to which a dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, Milo ready to drink
notes: Ready to drink Milo beverage. Major ingredients include water, milk solids, malted cereals, sugar, cocoa and flavours. Contains added calcium, iron, magnesium and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12 & D.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with Ovaltine powder & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from dry Ovaltine powder to which cow's milk is added.

name: Beverage, chocolate flavour, made with Ovaltine powder & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from dry Ovaltine powder to which dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Cocoa powder
notes: Powder produced from the liquor extracted from cocoa beans. Typically used to flavour beverages and in baking.

name: Bubble tea (boba tea), made with cow's milk & tapioca pearls, all flavours
notes: Beverage commonly prepared using a tea and milk base with added flavoured syrup and tapioca pearls.

name: Chai latte mix, with milk solids & sugar
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of milk solids, sugar, instant tea powder and flavours. Used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with water or milk.

name: Chai latte, made with chai mix powder & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from dry chai latte powder mix to which cow's milk is added.

name: Chai latte, made with chai mix powder & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from dry chai latte powder mix to which a dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Chai latte, made with chai mix powder & water
notes: Beverage prepared from dry chai latte powder mix to which hot water is added. Does not contain added milk.

name: Coffee, instant, dry powder
notes: Dried extract of coffee beans, used to produce a beverage by the addition of boiling water.

name: Coffee, instant, dry powder, decaffeinated
notes: Dried extract of decaffeinated coffee beans, used to produce a beverage by the addition of boiling water.

name: Coffee, black, from instant coffee powder
notes: Beverage made from instant coffee powder or granules to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, black, from instant coffee powder, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage made from instant decaffeinated coffee powder or granules to which boiling water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, black, Turkish, with sugar
notes: Turkish-style beverage produced by boiling ground coffee beans with water and sugar.

name: Coffee, espresso
notes: Beverage prepared from ground coffee beans and a small amount of hot water, as purchased in takeaway outlets or restaurants. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, espresso, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from decaffeinated ground coffee beans and a small amount of hot water, as purchased in takeaway outlets or restaurants. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & regular fat cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated regular fat cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & reduced fat cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated reduced fat cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & skim cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated skim cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, double shot & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a double shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & cow's milk, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & legume based milk (soy)
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated legume based dairy milk alternative (e.g. soy) is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & cereal based milk (rice/oat)
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated cereal based dairy milk alternative (e.g. rice or oat) is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & nut based milk (almond/coconut)
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated nut based dairy milk alternative (e.g. almond or coconut) is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, double shot & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from a double shot of espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added.

name: Coffee, flat white/cappuccino/latte, single shot & dairy milk alternative, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which a large amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, macchiato, single shot & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a small amount of heated and aerated cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, macchiato, single shot & cow's milk, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which a small amount of heated and aerated cow's milk is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, macchiato, single shot & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a small amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, macchiato, single shot & dairy milk alternative, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which a small amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added. Does not contain added flavour or sugar.

name: Coffee, mocha, single shot & cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which drinking chocolate powder and a large amount of heated and aerated undefined cow's milk is added. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Coffee, mocha, single shot & cow's milk, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which drinking chocolate powder and a large amount of heated and aerated undefined cow's milk is added. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Coffee, mocha, single shot & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which drinking chocolate powder and a large amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Coffee, mocha, single shot & dairy milk alternative, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of decaffeinated espresso style coffee to which drinking chocolate powder and a large amount of heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative is added. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Coffee, long black, single shot
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large volume of hot water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, long black, double shot
notes: Beverage prepared from a double shot of espresso style coffee to which a large volume of hot water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, long black, single shot, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared from a shot of espresso style coffee to which a large volume of hot water is added. Does not contain added flavour, milk or sugar.

name: Coffee, not further defined
notes: Undefined coffee, including caffeinated and decaffeinated varieties, made with water and milk, using dry instant coffee powder or coffee grounds, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Coffee & chicory essence, concentrate
notes: Thick paste containing extracts of coffee and chicory, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee & milk concentrate
notes: Thick, canned paste containing instant coffee, milk, sugar and salt, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee mix powder, with beverage whitener & sugar
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of milk solids, sugar, vegetable oil, maltodextrin and coffee, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee mix powder, with beverage whitener & sugar, decaffeinated
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of milk solids, sugar, maltodextrins, vegetable oil and decaffeinated coffee, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee mix powder, with beverage whitener & intense sweetener
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of milk solids, intense sweetener, maltodextrins, vegetable oil and coffee, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee mix powder, with beverage whitener & intense sweetener, decaffeinated
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of milk solids, intense sweeteners, vegetable oil and decaffeinated coffee, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water.

name: Coffee substitute mix, cereal based, dry powder
notes: Dried extract of roasted cereals (generally containing barley and rye), used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water. Commonly used as a substitute for coffee.

name: Coffee substitute mix, vegetable based, dry powder
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of vegetable powder, coconut, milk solids and spices, used to produce a hot beverage by mixing with hot water and/or milk. Commonly used as a substitute for coffee.

name: Coffee whitener, dry powder
notes: Dry product that is a mixture of glucose syrup, vegetable fat, sodium caseinate and food additives. Can be added to hot beverages in place of milk.

name: Coffee, made from coffee & milk concentrate & water
notes: Beverage made from concentrated coffee, milk and sugar mixture to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee, made from coffee mix with milk powder & water
notes: Beverage made from dry coffee mix with milk powder to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee, made from coffee mix with dairy milk alternative powder & water
notes: Beverage made from dry coffee mix with a dairy milk alternative powder to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee, made from coffee mix without added sugar & water
notes: Beverage made from dry coffee mix without added sugar to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee, made from decaffeinated coffee mix with milk powder & water
notes: Beverage made from dry, decaffeinated coffee mix with milk powder to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee, made from decaffeinated coffee mix with dairy milk alternative powder & water
notes: Beverage made from dry, decaffeinated coffee mix with a dairy milk alternative powder to which hot water is added.

name: Coffee substitute, made from cereal based powder & water
notes: Beverage made from dry cereal-based powder to which hot water is added. Commonly used as a substitute for coffee.

name: Coffee substitute, made from vegetable based powder & cow's milk
notes: Beverage made from dry vegetable-based powder to which heated cow's milk is added. Commonly used as a substitute for coffee.

name: Coffee substitute, made from vegetable based powder & dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage made from dry vegetable-based powder to which heated dairy milk alternative is added. Commonly used as a substitute for coffee.

name: Tea, black, dry
notes: Dried, fermented leaves of Camellia sinensis.

name: Tea, chai, instant dry powder
notes: Dry, instant tea powder used as an ingredient in commercial chai latte powder mix. May contain added flavours. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

name: Tea, green, dry
notes: Dried, unfermented leaves of Camellia sinensis.

name: Tea, black
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing black tea leaves in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.

name: Tea, black, decaffeinated
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing black decaffeinated tea leaves in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.

name: Tea, chai
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing plain or flavoured black tea leaves infused with spices in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

name: Tea, fruit infusions
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing dried fruit pieces, herbs & natural flavours in hot or cold water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

name: Tea, green
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing green tea leaves in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added flavours, milk or sugar.

name: Tea, herbal
notes: Beverage prepared by brewing dried leaves of plant or dried fruit extract in hot water, either as loose tea leaves or encased in porous teabags. Does not contain added milk or sugar.

name: Cordial base, 25% citrus fruit juice
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 25% citrus fruit juice (typically orange or lemon), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, 40% citrus fruit juice
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 40% citrus fruit juice (typically orange or lemon), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, 25% non-citrus fruit juice
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 25% non-citrus fruit juice (typically apple and berry), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, 40% non-citrus fruit juice
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 40% non-citrus fruit juice (typically apple and berry), used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, blackcurrant juice
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing at least 5% blackcurrant juice, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, blackcurrant juice, intense sweetened or diet
notes: Concentrated syrup containing at least 5% blackcurrant juice and intense sweeteners, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water. Includes varieties labelled as reduced/no added sugar, light or diet.

name: Cordial base, fruit juice/flavours
notes: Concentrated sugar-based syrup containing fruit juice or fruit flavour, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water.

name: Cordial base, fruit juice/flavours, intense sweetened or diet
notes: Concentrated syrup containing fruit juice or fruit flavour and intense sweeteners, used to prepare a beverage by dilution with water. Includes varieties labelled as reduced/no added sugar, light or diet.

name: Cordial base, non-fruit flavours

name: Sorghum, grain, uncooked
notes: Small, round grain that is orange-red in colour. Milled into flour or kibbled. Uncooked.

name: Spelt, uncooked
notes: Small grain from the wheat family. Uncooked.

name: Tapioca, uncooked
notes: Starchy product from the cassava plant supplied in the form of small pellets (known as seeds or pearls). Sometimes sold labelled as Sago tapioca or Sago. Uncooked.

name: Tapioca, cooked
notes: Tapioca prepared by boiling in water without the addition of fat or salt.

name: Teff, uncooked
notes: A very small grass seed which is white to a deep reddish brown in colour. Typically ground and used to make traditional flat bread such as injera. Uncooked.

name: Wheat bran, unprocessed, uncooked
notes: Outer layers of the wheat grain which are removed during the early stages of milling. May be coarsely or finely milled. Uncooked.

name: Wheat germ
notes: Small creamy flakes milled from the core of the wheat kernel.

name: Bagel, from white flour, commercial
notes: A ring of baked yeast dough with a chewy centre and a crusty outside, typically 8-10cm in diameter. Usually poached in water or steamed before being baked. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

name: Bagel, from white flour, commercial, toasted
notes: A ring of baked yeast dough with a chewy centre and a crusty outside. It is typically 8-10cm in diameter. Usually poached in water or steamed before being baked. Contains added folic acid and iodised salt. Cooked by toasting after purchase.

name: Breadcrumbs, white
notes: Crisp crumbs crushed from white bread which has been dried and packaged before sale. Contains added folic acid, iodised salt and thiamin.

name: Bread, corn
notes: Batter-style bread commonly made from cornmeal, wheat flour, milk, sugar, fat and salt.

name: Bread, croutons
notes: Commercial bread that has been cut into cubes and mixed with oil and salt before drying until crunchy.

name: Bread, damper, white, commercial

name: Bread, damper, white, commercial, toasted

name: Batter for coating food, uncooked
notes: A mixture of plain wheat flour, baking powder and water used to coat food before cooking. Uncooked.

name: Coating, for purchased frozen fish & seafood
notes: A mixture of plain wheat flour, starch, water, oil and salt used to coat frozen fish and seafood. Uncooked.

name: Butter, plain, salted
notes: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of water-in-oil emulsion, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Contains added salt.

name: Butter, plain, no added salt
notes: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of a water-in-oil emulsion, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Does not contain added salt.

name: Butter, plain, reduced salt (sodium <350 mg/100 g)
notes: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of a water-in-oil emulsion, containing no less than 80% milk fat. Formulated to contain less salt than regular butter.

name: Butter &/or dairy blend, garlic or herb
notes: A home prepared mixture of butter (salted or unsalted) or dairy blend with crushed garlic and chopped parsley.

name: Butter, not further defined
notes: A product derived exclusively from milk and products obtained from milk, principally in the form of a water-in-oil emulsion, containing no less than 80% milkfat. Includes regular salted and unsalted varieties weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Ghee, clarified butter
notes: A product made by melting butter and separating the milk solids and water from the fat (ghee). Contains at least 99.7% milk fat, used mainly in cooking.

name: Dairy blend
notes: A spread that is a blend of approximately two-thirds butter and one-third vegetable oil, generally canola oil, with a fat content of approximately 80%. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Dairy blend, reduced salt
notes: A spread that is a blend of approximately two-thirds butter and one-third vegetable oil, generally canola oil, with a fat content of approximately 80%. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular dairy blend. Contains added vitamin D. May contain added vitamin A.

name: Dairy blend, reduced fat
notes: A spread that is a blend of approximately one-half butter and one-third vegetable oil, generally canola oil, with a fat content of approximately 60%. Formulated to be lower in fat than regular dairy blend.  Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Dairy blend, reduced fat & salt
notes: A spread that is a blend of butter and vegetable oil, generally canola oil, with a fat content of approximately 60%. Formulated to be lower in fat and salt than regular dairy blend. Contains added vitamins A and D.

name: Dairy blend, not further defined
notes: A spread that is a blend of butter and vegetable oil. Includes regular, reduced fat and reduced salt varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated
notes: A spread containing approximately 70% fat, the majority of which are polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated, reduced salt
notes: A spread containing approximately 70% fat, the majority of which are polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Formulated to be lower in salt than regular polyunsaturated margarine spread. Contains added vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated, reduced fat
notes: A spread containing less than 50% fat, the majority of which are polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Formulated to be lower in fat than regular polyunsaturated margarine spread. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, polyunsaturated, added phytosterols
notes: A spread containing approximately 55% fat, the majority of which are polyunsaturated edible oils (including sunflower oil). Contains added phytosterols, salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated
notes: A spread containing approximately 65% fat, the majority of which are monounsaturated edible oils (including canola oil and olive oil). Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, reduced salt
notes: A spread containing approximately 65% fat, the majority of which are monounsaturated edible oils (including canola oil and olive oil). Formulated to be lower in salt than regular monounsaturated margarine spread. Contains added vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, reduced fat
notes: A spread containing less than 65% fat, the majority of which are monounsaturated edible oils (including canola oil and olive oil). Formulated to be lower in fat than regular monounsaturated margarine spread. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, olive oil
notes: An edible oil spread containing approximately 65% fat, the majority of which is monounsaturated olive oil. Contains added vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, olive oil, reduced fat
notes: An edible oil spread containing approximately 55% fat, the majority of which is monounsaturated olive oil. Formulated to be lower in fat than regular olice oil margarine spread. Contains added vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, dairy free
notes: A spread containing approximately 65% fat, the majority of which are monounsaturated edible oils (including canola oil and olive oil). Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, monounsaturated, dairy free, reduced fat
notes: A spread containing approximately 50% fat, the majority of which are monounsaturated edible oils (including canola oil and olive oil). Formulated to be lower in salt than regular dairy free margarine spread. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Margarine spread, regular fat & salt
notes: A spread containing approximately 65% fat, including both polyunsaturated and monounsaturated edible oils. Contains added salt. May include spreads identified as containing added vitamins.

name: Margarine spread, reduced salt
notes: A spread containing approximately 70% fat, including both polyunsaturated and monounsaturated edible oils. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular margarine spread. May include spreads identified as containing added vitamins.

name: Margarine spread, reduced fat
notes: A spread containing approximately 55% fat, including both polyunsaturated and monounsaturated edible oils. Formulated to be lower in fat than regular margarine spread. May include spreads identified as containing added vitamins.

name: Margarine spread, not further defined
notes: A monounsaturated or polyunsaturated edible oil spread. Includes regular fat, reduced fat, reduced salt, dairy free and added phytosterol varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Margarine, cooking
notes: A product made with animal fats, containing no less than 80% fat. This is a harder-style product formulated for domestic baking. Contains added salt and vitamins A and D.

name: Fat, butter, dairy blend or margarine spread, not further defined
notes: Butter, dairy blend or magarine spread. Includes regular, reduced fat and/or salt and added phytosterols varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Oil, almond

name: Oil, avocado

name: Oil, blend of polyunsaturated vegetable oils

name: Oil, canola
notes: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the canola plant (Brassica napus or Brassica campestris). Although derived from the same plant, canola oil is not rapeseed oil, and it is distinguished by low levels of erucic acid.

name: Oil, coconut
notes: Edible oil extracted from the flesh and milk of coconuts (Cocos nucifera). The oil is white and solid at room temperature.

name: Oil, cottonseed
notes: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the cotton plant.

name: Oil, grapeseed
notes: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of grapes.

name: Oil, hemp
notes: Edible oil extracted from the ripened fruits (seeds) of the hemp plant (Cannabis sativa). Refined or unrefined, cold pressed.

name: Oil, linseed or flaxseed
notes: Edible oil extracted from linseeds/flaxseeds.

name: Oil, mustard seed
notes: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the mustard plant (Sinapsis alba and Brassica nigra).

name: Oil, macadamia
notes: Edible oil extracted from the macadamia nut (Macadamia integrifolia).

name: Oil, maize (corn)
notes: Edible oil extracted from the kernel of corn or maize (Zea mays).

name: Oil, olive
notes: Edible oil extracted the flesh of the olive (Olea europaea).

name: Oil, palm

name: Oil, peanut

name: Oil, rice bran

name: Oil, safflower

name: Oil, sesame

name: Oil, soybean
notes: Edible oil extracted from the seeds of the soybean plant (Glycine maximus).

name: Oil, sunflower

name: Oil, vegetable

name: Oil, not further defined

name: Oil, for use in baked product recipes & deep fried takeaway foods

name: Fat, cocoa butter

name: Fat, duck
notes: Fat rendered from the meat, muscles and bones of ducks.

name: Fat, solid, animal based
notes: Fat rendered from the meat, muscles and bones of animals.

name: Fat, solid, vegetable oil based

name: Oil, copha
notes: Solidified edible oil extracted from the flesh and milk of coconuts (Cocos nucifera), used in baking.

name: Fat or oil, not further defined, for use in meat, fish, poultry & mixed dish recipes
notes: Oil or fat, including vegetable oils, butter and margarine, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study, when respondents have reported oil or fat use in cooking meat, fish, chicken, dry cooked vegetables and mixed dishes.

name: Shortening, animal fat (for short pastry, pie bases, tarts & flans), commercial

name: Shortening, vegetable fat (for coatings, creams, icings, confectionery & fillings), commercial

name: Shortening, vegetable fat (for flaky pastry, pie tops, sausage rolls & danishes), commercial

May be natural or sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 2%.

name: Yoghurt, flavoured/added fruit, reduced fat (~2%), homemade
notes: Homemade yoghurt prepared by culturing cow's milk, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt with a fat content of approximately 2%. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, flavoured/added fruit, low fat (<1%), high protein
notes: Yoghurt prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cow's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings. Supplied with a fat content of less than 1% and a higher protein content than other low fat yoghurt.

measures.label: 1 tub or container Yoplait Forme, Gippsland

name: Yoghurt, flavoured/added fruit, low fat (<1%), no added sugar, added fibre
notes: Yoghurt prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cow's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. The yoghurt is sweetened without added sugar and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings. Contains added dietary fibre in the form of polydextrose. Supplied with a fat content less than 1%.

name: Yoghurt, flavoured/added fruit, low fat (<1%), no added sugar, high protein
notes: Yoghurt prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cow's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. The yoghurt is then sweetened without added sugar and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings. Supplied with a fat content of less than 1% and a higher protein content than other low fat yoghurt.

name: Yoghurt, flavoured/added fruit, with muesli or nut additions
notes: Yoghurt prepared by pasteurising and homogenising cow's milk before culturing, resulting in a thickened, tangy yoghurt. The yoghurt is then sweetened without added sugar and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings. Contains added muesli/granola and mixed nuts. May contain dessert-style additions such as cookie pieces and caramel.

name: Cream, rich or double thick
notes: Rich or double thick cream made by separating cow's milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk). May contain thickener or vegetable gums to increase the viscosity. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 49%.

name: Cream, thickened
notes: Thickened cream made by separating cow's milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk) and adding thickener to increase the viscosity. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 35%.

name: Cream, thickened, lactose free
notes: Thickened cream made by separating cow's milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk) and adding thickener to increase the viscosity. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 35%. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Cream, thickened, light (~18% fat)
notes: Thickened cream made by separating cow's milk into a highly concentrated milk fat stream (cream) and a non-milk fat stream (skim milk) and adding thickener to increase the viscosity. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 18%.

name: Cream, whipped, aerosol
notes: Aerosol whipped cream prepared by mixing cream with a propellant (usually nitrous oxide) and various stabilisers, emulsifiers and sugar, then packing under pressure. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 28%.

name: Cream, whipped, aerosol, reduced fat (~18%)
notes: Aerosol whipped cream prepared by mixing cream with a propellant (usually nitrous oxide) and various stabilisers, emulsifiers and sugar, then packing under pressure. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 18%.

name: Cream, whipped, aerosol, flavoured
notes: Aerosol whipped cream prepared by mixing cream with a propellant (usually nitrous oxide) and various stabilisers, emulsifiers, sugar and flavours, then packing under pressure. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 28%.

name: Cream, imitation or mock (non-dairy)
notes: Commercially produced soft product with a creamy appearance and texture that is commonly used in baked goods in place of whipped dairy cream, but which is not dairy-based.

name: Cream, dairy, sugar sweetened, whipped
notes: Dairy cream that has been whipped and sweetened with icing sugar.

name: Cream, dairy, not further defined
notes: Dairy cream including rich or double thick, regular and reduced fat thickened and aerosol varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Cream, sour
notes: Sour cream made by culturing cream with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 35%.

name: Cream, sour, light (~18% fat)
notes: Sour cream made by culturing cream with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 18%.

name: Cream, sour, light (~18% fat), lactose free
notes: Sour cream made by culturing cream with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 18%. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Cream, sour, dairy, not further defined
notes: Sour cream made by culturing cream with lactic acid bacteria resulting in the sour flavour. Includes regular fat and reduced fat varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Cheese spread, cream cheese
notes: Cheese spread made from cream and cheese with added sugar and salt.

name: Cheese spread, cream cheese, reduced fat
notes: Cheese spread made from cream and cheese with added sugar and salt. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 20%.

name: Cheese, blended, regular fat
notes: A blend of mozzarella, cheddar and parmesan cheeses, pre-grated, commonly used for placing on top of pizzas before baking.

name: Cheese, blue vein
notes: Cheese prepared by the addition of culture, rennet and mould spores to cow's milk to produce green, grey, blue or black spots of mould throughout the body of the cheese.

name: Cheese, bocconcini
notes: Cheese prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cow's milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then formed into small balls. These are then packed in brine or water.

name: Cheese, brie
notes: Cheese prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cow's milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft cheese covered with white mould.

name: Cheese, camembert
notes: Cheese prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cow's milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft, creamy, surface-ripened cheese.

name: Cheese, cheddar, natural, plain
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard, pale-yellow cheese. Includes mild, tasty and vintage varieties.

name: Cheese, cheddar, natural, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard, pale-yellow cheese. Includes mild, tasty and vintage varieties. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 25%.

name: Cheese, cheddar, natural, flavoured
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard, pale-yellow cheese. Flavoured with the addition of small quantities of pepper, herbs, dried tomato, and/or onion. May contain added preservatives.

name: Cheese, cheddar, processed
notes: Cheese prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied as slices or blocks.

name: Cheese, cheddar, processed, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. Commonly supplied as slices with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Cheese, cheddar, processed, babybel style
notes: Cheese prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. Supplied in small round packets or wedges.

name: Cheese, cheddar, processed, stick style
notes: Cheese prepared by grinding, mixing, melting and emulsifying one or more varieties of cheese with salt to form a homogeneous mass. The cheese in then extruded into a stick shape.

name: Cheese, colby style
notes: Cheese prepared similarly to cheddar except the curd is washed and cooled resulting in a semi-hard cheese that is less tangy than cheddar.

name: Cheese, cottage
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cow's milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese.

name: Cheese, cottage, lactose free
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cow's milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Cheese, cottage, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cow's milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 2%.

name: Cheese, cottage, flavoured
notes: Cottage cheese flavoured with additions such as sweet chilli sauce, onion and chives. May contain added preservatives.

name: Cheese, cream, plain
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese.

name: Cheese, cream, plain, lactose free
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Cheese, cream, plain, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 20%.

name: Cheese, cream, fruit flavoured
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese. Flavoured with the addition of dried fruit, with or without other additions such as nuts. May contain added preservatives.

name: Cheese, cream, herb or spice flavoured
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese. Flavoured with the addition of small quantities of herbs and spices such as chives, onion, chilli flakes and/or peppercorns. May contain added preservatives.

name: Cheese, edam
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a semi-hard cheese that is then coated in oil or a red or yellow wax film.

name: Cheese, fetta (feta)
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and stored in either whey or brine. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 20%.

name: Cheese, fetta (feta), lactose free
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling dairy milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and stored in either whey or brine. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 20%. Does not contain lactose.

name: Cheese, fetta (feta), reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and stored in either whey or brine. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Cheese, fetta (feta), marinated
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, which is then sliced, salted and marinated in an oil blend (typically canola and olive) with herbs.

name: Cheese, goat, soft
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling goat's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a soft, white cheese.

name: Cheese, gouda
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a semi-hard, yellow cheese that is then coated in a wax rind.

name: Cheese, haloumi (halloumi)
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling dairy milk with rennet, then boiling the curds and storing in salted whey to produce a salty, semi-soft cheese.

name: Cheese, haloumi (halloumi), reduced salt
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling dairy milk with rennet, then boiling the curds and storing in salted whey to produce a salty, semi-soft cheese. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular haloumi.

name: Cheese, havarti
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a semi-hard, pale-yellow cheese.

name: Cheese, hard, lactose free
notes: Cheddar-style cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard cheese. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Includes block, shredded and sliced cheese.

name: Cheese, hard, flavoured, lactose free
notes: Cheddar-style cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard cheese. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose. Flavoured with additions such as honey, garlic, pepper, chilli, dried fruit and herbs.

name: Cheese, mascarpone
notes: Cheese prepared by blending, culturing and salting cow's milk, cream and vegetable gum to produce a soft, white cheese.

name: Cheese, mozzarella
notes: Cheese prepared by culturing and coagulating cow's milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then shaped. Characterised by it's stringy consistency when heated.

name: Cheese, mozzarella, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by culturing and coagulating cow's milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then shaped. Characterised by it's stringy consistency when heated. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Cheese, mozzarella, buffalo
notes: Cheese prepared by culturing and coagulating buffalo milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then shaped. Characterised by it's stringy consistency when heated.

name: Cheese, mozzarella, coated, fried
notes: Small baton-shaped stick of mozzarella cheese, lightly coated and crumbed then fried until golden.

name: Cheese, parmesan, dried, finely grated
notes: Cheese prepared by removing the majority of cream from cow's milk before heating, curdling and brining to produce a hard, granular cheese. Cheese is finely grated prior to sale and some additional moisture may be removed, so that the cheese does not generally require refrigerator storage.

name: Cheese, parmesan, fresh
notes: Cheese prepared by removing the majority of cream from cow's milk before heating, curdling and brining to produce a hard, granular cheese.

name: Cheese, provolone style
notes: Cheese prepared by culturing and coagulating cow's milk to form curds that are stretched and kneaded until smooth, then shaped. The cheese is then coated in a wax rind.

name: Cheese, quark
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling, salting, draining and washing cow's milk to produce an unripened, white curd cheese.

name: Cheese, ricotta
notes: Cheese prepared by collecting the curds leftover in the whey after the coagulation of cow's milk and further separating and draining.

name: Cheese, ricotta, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by collecting the curds leftover in the whey after the coagulation of cow's milk and further separating and draining. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 5%.

name: Cheese, smoked, regular fat
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard cheese. The cheese is then smoked or has smoke flavour added.

name: Cheese, soft, white mould coated, not further defined
notes: Cheese prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cow's milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft cheese covered with white mould. Includes brie, double brie and camembert.

name: Cheese, soft, lactose free
notes: Camembert-style cheese prepared by pasteurising, culturing and coagulating cow's milk prior to salting and curing to produce a soft, creamy, surface-ripened cheese. Does not contain lactose.

name: Cheese, sheep
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling sheep milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a soft, white cheese.

name: Cheese, swiss or jarlsberg
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard to semi-hard, yellow cheese containing characteristic holes. Often sold with a wax rind.

name: Cheese, swiss or jarlsberg, reduced fat
notes: Cheese prepared by curdling cow's milk with rennet, followed by curing to produce a hard to semi-hard, yellow cheese containing characteristic holes. Often sold with a wax rind. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Cheese, for use in garden salads
notes: Cheese which as been used as an ingredient in garden salads. Includes a variety of cheeses (such as cheddar, colby, parmesan) weighted according to consumption patterns observed in the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Cheese, for use on sandwiches
notes: Cheese which has been used as a sandwich filling. Includes a variety of cheeses (such as cheddar, colby, swiss, provolone) weighted according to consumption patterns observed in the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Gelato or sorbet, water-based, fruit flavoured
notes: Ice confection containing fruit or fruit juice. Major ingredients include fruit or fruit juices, sugar and water. Frozen prior to sale and sold in a tub, cup or cone. Does not contain dairy.

name: Gelato or sorbet, milk based, chocolate or coffee flavoured
notes: Ice confection containing chocolate or coffee flavour. Major ingredients include milk, cream, sugar, milk solids, cocoa/coffee powder and vegetable gums. Frozen prior to sale and sold in a tub, cup or cone.

name: Gelato or sorbet, milk based, non-chocolate or coffee flavours
notes: Ice confection containing vanilla or other flavours such as toffee and caramel. Major ingredients include milk, sugar, cream, milk solids, flavours and vegetable gums. Frozen prior to sale and sold in a tub, cup or cone.

name: Ice cream, chocolate, premium or rich (~15% fat)
notes: Premium or rich chocolate flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising cream, milk, sugar, chocolate, gums and emulsifiers, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Ice cream, chocolate, premium or rich (~15% fat), with sweet additions
notes: Premium or rich chocolate ice cream prepared by homogenising cream, milk, sugar, chocolate, gums, emulsifiers and other sweet additions such as caramel and brownie, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, premium or rich (~15% fat)
notes: Premium or rich vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising cream, milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, premium or rich (~15% fat), with sweet additions
notes: Premium or rich vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising cream, milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers, vanilla flavour and other sweet additions such as caramel and brownie, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 15%.

name: Ice cream, chocolate or coffee flavour
notes: Chocolate or coffee flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, cocoa/coffee, gums and emulsifiers, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 7%.

name: Ice cream, chocolate or coffee flavour, low fat (~3%)
notes: Chocolate or coffee flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, cocoa/coffee, gums and emulsifiers, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 3%.

name: Ice cream, fried
notes: Firmly frozen balls of vanilla ice cream coated in a batter and fried in hot oil until golden.

name: Ice cream, fruit flavour
notes: Fruit flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and fruit, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 11%.

name: Ice cream, fruit flavour, low fat (~3%)
notes: Fruit flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and fruit, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 3%.

name: Ice cream, neapolitan
notes: Neapolitan ice cream typically comprised of equal quantities of vanilla, strawberry and chocolate ice cream.

name: Ice cream, other flavours
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and flavours, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 10%.

name: Ice cream, other flavours, low fat (~3%)
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and flavours, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 3%.

name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 11%.

name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, low fat (~3%)
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 3%.

measures.label: 1 slice Peters Light & Creamy Vanilla Ice Cream Slice

name: Ice cream, with chocolate chips
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, cream, sugar, gums, emulsifiers, flavours and chocolate chips, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture.

name: Ice cream, with nuts
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers, flavours and nuts (usually macadamia, pecan or pistachio), then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 13%.

name: Ice cream, with sweet additions
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers, flavours and and other sweet additions such as caramel and cookie, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 12%.

name: Ice cream, with fruit based ice confection
notes: Frozen ice confection consisting of ice cream combined with frozen fruit ice.

name: Ice cream, all flavours, homemade
notes: Homemade flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, cream, sugar, egg yolk and flavourings, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture.

name: Ice cream, all flavours, lactose free
notes: Commercial product prepared by mixing milk, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream to give it a light texture. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Ice cream, all flavours, no added sugar
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by homogenising milk, sorbitol, polydextrose, cream, emulsifiers, gums, flavour and intense sweetener, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Does not contain added sugar. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 3%.

name: Ice cream, cake, not further defined
notes: Flavoured ice cream moulded into a cake. May contain chocolate or confectionery additions.

name: Ice cream, cone, with confectionery, chocolate coated
notes: Frozen ice confection consisting of ice cream in a waffle cone with chocolate coating inside the cone and on top of the ice cream, containing nuts and/or sugar coated chocolate pieces spread throughout the ice cream.

name: Ice cream, cone, soft serve, fast food style
notes: Vanilla flavoured soft serve ice cream served in a wafer cone, as served in fast food outlets.

name: Ice cream, sandwich, vanilla flavour, with chocolate flavour biscuit
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream sandwiched between chocolate flavoured biscuits.

name: Ice cream, sandwich, vanilla flavour, with chocolate flavour biscuit & chocolate coated
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream sandwiched between chocolate flavoured biscuits, then coated in chocolate.

name: Ice cream, sandwich, vanilla flavour, with chocolate flavour biscuit, reduced fat
notes: Reduced fat vanilla flavoured ice cream sandwiched between chocolate flavoured biscuits.

name: Ice cream, vanilla flavour, soft serve, fast food chain
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared in fast food outlets by homogenising milk, milk solids, cream, sugar, gums, emulsifiers and vanilla flavour, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 5%.

name: Ice cream, soft serve, vanilla, with chocolate cream filled biscuit, fast food chain
notes: Vanilla flavoured soft serve ice cream served with added pieces of chocolate flavoured cream filled biscuit mixed throughout, as served in fast food outlets.

name: Ice cream, stick, chocolate coated
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture prior to moulding on a stick and coating in chocolate.

name: Ice cream, stick, chocolate coated with nuts
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture prior to moulding on a stick and coating in chocolate and nuts.

name: Ice cream, stick, flavoured, chocolate & biscuit crumb coated
notes: Flavoured ice cream prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture prior to moulding on a stick and coating in chocolate and biscuit crumbs.

name: Ice cream, stick, vanilla flavour, fruit ice confection coated
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture prior to moulding on a stick and coating in fruit ice confection.

name: Ice cream, stick, vanilla flavour, with caramel sauce, chocolate coated
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream prepared by freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the ice cream and give a light texture prior to moulding on a stick and coating in caramel sauce and chocolate.

name: Ice confection, chocolate bar flavours
notes: Frozen ice confection formulated to resemble chocolate bars such as Mars Bar and Picnic.

name: Ice confection, stick, milk based, chocolate flavoured
notes: Milk-based, chocolate flavoured ice confection prepared by homogenising skim milk, milk solids, sugar, water, cocoa powder, emulsifiers and gums prior to moulding on a stick.

name: Ice confection, stick, milk based, non-chocolate flavours
notes: Milk-based ice confection prepared by homogenising skim milk, milk solids, sugar, water, flavours, emulsifiers and gums prior to moulding on a stick.

name: Ice confection, stick, water-based, all flavours
notes: Water-based ice confection prepared by homogenising water, sugar, food acid, gums, flavours and colours prior to moulding on a stick.

name: Ice confection, stick or tub, fruit flavoured
notes: Fruit juice or fruit flavoured ice confection prepared by homogenising water, fruit juice(s), sugar, food acid, gums, flavours and colours prior to moulding on a stick or packing in a tub.

name: Mochi, ice cream filled, all flavours
notes: Small, round, rice cake made of glutinous rice, sugar and water, then filled with ice cream or other creamy fillings.

name: Sundae, ice cream with topping, fast food chain
notes: Vanilla flavoured soft serve ice cream with flavoured topping such as chocolate and caramel, as served in fast food outlets.

name: Sundae, vanilla ice cream, with topping
notes: Vanilla flavoured ice cream with flavoured topping such as chocolate, strawberry or caramel.

name: Yoghurt, frozen, fruit flavoured
notes: Fruit flavoured frozen yoghurt prepared by homogenising milk, fruit or fruit juice, sugar, gums, emulsifiers, colours, flavours and cultures, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate the yoghurt and give it a light texture. Supplied with a fat content of of approximately 3%.

name: Yoghurt, frozen, protein increased, no added sugar
notes: Flavoured ice cream or frozen yoghurt prepared by homogenising water, milk solids, emulsifiers and gums, then freezing rapidly with agitation to aerate and give a light texture. Contains added polydextrose and xylitol. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Custard, dairy, chocolate, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, chocolate flavoured custard made from milk, sugar, thickener, cocoa powder, stabilisers and flavour. Does not contain eggs.

1 pouch or tub single serve large

name: Custard, dairy, vanilla, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, vanilla flavoured custard made from milk, sugar, thickener, milk solids, stabilisers, flavour and colour. Does not contain eggs.

1 pouch or tub single serve large

name: Custard, dairy, vanilla, reduced fat, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, vanilla flavoured custard made from skim milk, milk solids, thickener, sugar, stabilisers, flavour, colour and sweeteners. Does not contain eggs. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 1%.

1 pouch or tub single serve large

name: Custard, dairy, vanilla, lactose free, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, vanilla flavoured custard made from milk, sugar, thickener, milk solids, stabilisers, flavour and colour. Does not contain eggs. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Custard, dairy, fruit flavoured, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, fruit flavoured (such as strawberry, banana) custard made from milk, sugar, thickener, milk solids, stabilisers, flavours and colours. May contain added fruit or fruit juice. Does not contain eggs.
