1 pouch or tub single serve large

name: Custard, egg, vanilla, homemade
notes: Homemade, vanilla flavoured egg custard made from milk, sugar, egg yolk and thickener.

name: Custard powder, dry mix, commercial
notes: Dry, yellow powder used for making custard. Ingredients include cornflour, sugar, salt, colours and flavours.

name: Custard, dairy, vanilla, made from dry mix
notes: Vanilla custard made from milk, commercial dry mix and sugar according to label instructions.

name: Custard pudding, creme caramel or brulee, vanilla, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, vanilla flavoured custard pudding made from milk, cream, sugar, thickener, flavour and colour, then topped with a caramel sauce or burnt sugar. Custard does not contain eggs.

name: Custard pudding, crème caramel or brulee, flavoured, homemade
notes: Homemade, vanilla flavoured custard pudding made from cream, sugar, egg yolk and flavour. Topped with sugar after baking and then torched or grilled to caramelise the sugar.

name: Dairy dessert, children's, chocolate, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, chocolate flavoured dairy dessert intended for children made from milk, sugar, milk solids, thickeners, cocoa powder, flavours and salt.

name: Dairy dessert, children's, non-chocolate flavours, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, flavoured dairy dessert intended for children made from milk, sugar, milk solids, thickeners, cocoa powder, flavours and salt.

name: Dairy dessert, chocolate, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, chocolate flavoured dairy dessert made from milk, sugar, chocolate and/or cocoa, vegetable gums, thickeners, emulsifiers and flavours.

name: Dairy dessert, non-chocolate flavours, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, non-chocolate flavoured dairy dessert made from milk, sugar, vegetable gums, emulsifiers and flavours.

name: Dairy dessert, chocolate, added vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D, Ca & Fe, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared, chocolate flavoured dairy dessert made from milk, sugar, formulated supplementary beverage base (contains added calcium and iron and vitamins B2, B3, B6, B12, C & D), flavour and thickener.

name: Fondue, cheese
notes: Melted cheese dish traditionally served in a communal pot for dipping bread.

name: Fromais frais (fromage frais), vanilla flavoured
notes: Creamy dessert of whipped yoghurt made from concentrated milk, sugar, and flavours. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 3%. May contain added calcium and vitamin D.

name: Fromais frais (fromage frais), fruit flavoured
notes: Creamy dessert of whipped yoghurt made from concentrated milk, sugar, strawberries and natural flavours. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 3%. May contain added calcium and vitamin D.

name: Mousse, chocolate, homemade
notes: Homemade dairy dessert made from cream, chocolate (typically dark), eggs, butter and sugar.

name: Mousse, strawberry, homemade
notes: Homemade dairy dessert made from cream, strawberries, sugar, egg white and gelatine.

name: Panna cotta, dairy, vanilla, homemade
notes: Homemade vanilla flavoured dairy dessert made from milk, cream, yoghurt or buttermilk and sugar, then set with gelatine.

name: Pudding, chia
notes: Sweet dessert made from chia seeds soaked in liquid (such as water, milk, dairy alternative) and sweetener (such as honey, maple syrup).

name: Pudding, rice, dairy, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared sweet dessert made from dairy milk, cooked rice, sugar and flavours. Includes chilled and shelf-stable varieties.

name: Pudding, rice, dairy, homemade
notes: Homemade sweet dessert made from dairy milk, cooked rice, sugar and flavours.

name: Pudding, rice, coconut cream, homemade
notes: Homemade sweet dessert made from cooked rice, coconut milk or cream, water and sugar.

name: Trifle, homemade
notes: Homemade, layered dessert commonly made from plain cake (usually sponge or sponge rolls) soaked in sherry, jelly, dairy custard and fruit (such as berries or peaches).

name: Tiramisu, coffee, homemade
notes: Homemade, layered dessert commonly made with sponge fingers, mascarpone cheese, cream, coffee and liqueur.

name: Eggnog (egg nog), made from cow's milk, egg & sugar
notes: Beverage commonly prepared using milk, cream, egg, sugar, alcohol (such as brandy or rum) and sweet spices.

name: Babyccino, from cow's milk
notes: Beverage, commonly described as 'babyccino', prepared from heated and aerated undefined cow's milk and sprinkled with drinking chocolate. Does not contain coffee, added flavour or sugar.

name: Babyccino, from dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage, commonly described as 'babyccino', prepared from heated and aerated undefined dairy milk alternative and sprinkled with drinking chocolate. Does not contain coffee, added flavour or sugar.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, regular fat
notes: Regular fat cow's milk containing added sugar and flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, regular fat, lactose free
notes: Regular fat cow's milk containing added sugar and flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, regular fat, no added sugar
notes: Regular fat cow's milk containing added flavours such as coffee, chocolate, strawberry or vanilla. May contain artificial sweeteners. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, reduced fat
notes: Reduced fat cow's milk containing added sugar and flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, reduced fat, lactose free
notes: Reduced fat cow's milk containing added sugar and flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla. Lactase enzyme added to pre-digest naturally-occurring lactose.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, reduced fat, added vitamins
notes: Reduced fat cow's milk containing added sugar and flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla. Contains added vitamins A & D.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, reduced fat, added vitamins & minerals
notes: Reduced fat, flavoured supplementary beverage containing a range of added vitamins and minerals. Also contains added sugar, emulsifier and flavourings. Sustagen is an example of this food.

name: Flavoured milk, cow's, reduced fat, no added sugar
notes: Reduced fat cow's milk containing added flavours such as chocolate, strawberry or vanilla.

name: Iced chocolate, made with cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing cow's milk, vanilla ice cream and chocolate flavoured syrup, then topping with whipped cream.

name: Iced coffee, commercially packaged
notes: Commercially prepared beverage containing cow's milk and added sugar, coffee extract or powder. May contain added colours or flavours.

name: Iced coffee, made with cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing cow's milk, vanilla ice cream, ice and cooled espresso coffee, then topping with whipped cream.

name: Milkshake, made with regular fat cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing regular fat cow's milk and flavoured topping. May contain ice cream.

name: Milkshake, made with reduced fat cow's milk
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing reduced fat cow's milk and flavoured topping. May contain ice cream.

name: Smoothie, made with cow's milk & added fruit
notes: Beverage prepared by blending cow's milk with fresh mixed fruit (such as banana, berries, melon, mango) and other ingredients such as honey, ice cream or yoghurt. May contain topping or flavouring.

name: Smoothie, made with cow's milk & added fruit & nuts or seeds
notes: Beverage prepared by blending cow's milk with fresh mixed fruit (such as banana, berries, melon, mango), nuts and/or seeds and other ingredients such as honey, ice cream or yoghurt. May contain topping or flavouring.

name: Smoothie, made with fruit juice & added fruit
notes: Beverage prepared by blending fruit juice (such as apple, pineapple, pear, tropical, orange) with mixed fruit (such as banana, mango, berries).

name: Smoothie, made with fruit juice & added fruit & nuts or seeds
notes: Beverage prepared by blending fruit juice (such as apple, pineapple, pear, tropical, orange) with mixed fruit (such as banana, mango, berries), nuts and/or seeds.

name: Smoothie, made with dairy milk alternative & added fruit
notes: Beverage prepared by blending non-dairy beverage (such as soy or rice beverage) with fresh mixed fruit (typically banana, berries and mango) and other ingredients such as honey, non-dairy ice confection or non-dairy yoghurt. With or without topping or flavouring.

name: Spider, with cola & ice cream
notes: Beverage prepared by placing scoops of ice cream into cola flavoured soft drink.

name: Thickshake, made with cow's milk, all flavours
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing cow's milk, ice cream and flavoured syrup.

name: Thickshake, made with cow's milk, all flavours, fast food chain
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing cow's milk, soft serve ice cream and flavoured syrup, as served in fast food outlets.

name: Almond beverage, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and almonds. Can be unsweetened or sweetened with sugar or rice syrup. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Almond beverage, added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and almonds. Can be unsweetened or sweetened with sugar or rice syrup. Contains added calcium.

name: Almond beverage, added Ca & vitamin B1, B2 & B12
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and almonds, then sweetened with sugar. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B12 and calcium.

name: Almond beverage, added sugar, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sunflower oil and salt. Product is sweetened with sugar or rice syrup but does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Almond beverage, added sugar & Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sunflower oil and salt. Product is sweetened with sugar or syrup and contains added calcium.

name: Almond beverage, no added sugar, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds, sunflower oil and salt. Does not contain added sugar or vitamins or minerals.

name: Almond beverage, no added sugar, added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water, almonds and salt. Does not contain added sugar but does contain added calcium.

name: Almond beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and almonds, with or without added sugar, fortified or unfortified, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Cashew beverage
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and cashews. Does not contain added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

name: Coconut beverage, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and coconut milk or cream. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Coconut beverage, added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and coconut milk or cream. Contains added calcium.

name: Coconut beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and coconut milk or cream, fortified or unfortified, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Hazelnut beverage
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and hazelnuts. Does not contain added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

name: Macadamia beverage
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and macadamias. Contains added sugar but does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Nut beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from nuts, such as almond and coconut, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Oat beverage, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and oats. Does not contain added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

name: Oat beverage, added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and oats. Does not contain added sugar but contains added calcium.

name: Oat beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and oats, fortified or unfortified, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Quinoa beverage
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and quinoa, sweetened with agave syrup. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Rice beverage, unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and brown rice. Does not contain added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

name: Rice beverage, added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and brown rice. Does not contain added sugar but contains added calcium.

name: Rice beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and brown rice, fortified or unfortified, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Cereal beverage, not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from cereals, such as oat and rice, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Pea protein beverage, added vitamins & minerals
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and pea protein isolate. Contains added vitamins A, B2, B12, D and calcium and phosphorus. Does not contain added sugar.

name: Seed beverage
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and seeds (such as hemp or sesame). Does not contain added sugar, vitamins or minerals.

name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 3%. Contains added sugar. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 3%. Contains added sugar and calcium.

name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), added vitamins & minerals
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 3%. Contains added sugar, vitamins and minerals.

name: Soy beverage, regular fat (~3%), not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 3%. Includes fortified and unfortified varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Soy beverage, reduced fat (~1% fat), unfortified
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 1%. Contains added sugar but does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Soy beverage, reduced fat (~1.5% fat), added Ca
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 1.5%. Contains added sugar and calcium.

name: Soy beverage, reduced fat (~1%), added vitamins & minerals
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 1%. Contains added sugar, vitamins A, B1, B2, B12, D and calcium, phosphorus and magnesium.

name: Soy beverage, reduced fat (~1%), not further defined
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans with a fat content of approximately 1%. Includes fortified and unfortified varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Dairy milk alternative, unflavoured, not further defined
notes: Non-dairy beverage (such as soy, oat, rice, almond, coconut), commonly used as a milk substitute. Includes fortified and unfortified varieties, weighted according to consumption patterns observed during the 2023 National Nutrition and Physical Activity Study.

name: Soy beverage, powder
notes: Dairy milk substitute made from soy beans and spray dried into a powder.

name: Yoghurt, almond, natural
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from almond beverage. Does not contain added fruit or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, almond, flavoured/added fruit
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from almond beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, cashew, flavoured
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from cashew beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, coconut, natural
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from coconut beverage and cultures. Does not contain added fruit or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, coconut, flavoured/added fruit
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from coconut beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, coconut, flavoured/added fruit, with additions
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from coconut beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings, with muesli, nut or dessert-style additions.

name: Yoghurt, coconut, flavoured/added fruit, intense sweetened
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from coconut beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened without added sugar and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, oat based
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from oat beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, soy based, natural
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from soy beverage and cultures. Does not contain added fruit or flavourings.

name: Yoghurt, soy based, flavoured/added fruit
notes: A dairy yoghurt substitute made from soy beverage and cultures. The yoghurt is then sweetened and flavoured with fruit and/or flavourings.

name: Cream, dairy alternative
notes: Non-dairy product with a soft, creamy appearance and texture that is manufactured to be a substitute for dairy-based cream. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 30%.

name: Cream, sour, dairy alternative
notes: Coconut-based product with a soft, creamy appearance and texture that is manufactured to be a substitute for dairy-based sour cream. Supplied with a fat content of approximately 25%.

name: Cheese, hard, dairy alternative
notes: Commercially produced dairy cheese alternative with a firm texture and cheese-like appearance. Typical ingredients include water, vegetable oils, starch, salt, natural flavours and colourings. May contain added calcium.

name: Cheese, soft, dairy alternative
notes: Commercially produced dairy cheese alternative with a soft texture and cheese-like appearance. Typical ingredients include water, vegetable oils, starch, salt, natural flavours and colourings. May contain added calcium.

name: Ice confection, oat based, all flavours
notes: Oat-based ice confection prepared by homogenising oat beverage, sugar and flavourings. Some products contain added vitamins (B1, B3, folic acid) or intense sweeteners (erythritol, steviol glycosides).

name: Ice confection, nut based, all flavours
notes: Nut-based ice confection prepared by homogenising nut beverages (such as coconut, almond, cashew), sugar, flavourings and vegetable gums. Products may contain added nuts.

name: Ice confection, soy based, all flavours
notes: Soy-based ice confection prepared by homogenising soy beverage, sugar, flavourings, emulsifiers and vegetable gums.

name: Ice confection, stick or cone, dairy alternative, all flavours
notes: Ice confection prepared by homogenising dairy alternative beverage, sugar, flavourings, emulsifiers and vegetable gums, in a cone or on a stick. Product is commonly chocolate coated, or contains additions such as dairy-free chocolate, syrups and nuts. Vegan Magnum and Vegan Cornetto are examples of this food.

name: Almond beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and almonds, with added salt and flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. Products are usually sweetened with sugar. Contains added calcium and may contain added vitamins such as B2 and B12.

name: Coconut beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from coconut water and coconut milk, with added sweetener (such as coconut flower nectar), salt and flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Hazelnut beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and hazelnuts, with added sweetener (such as rice malt syrup) and flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. Does not contain vitamins or minerals.

name: Oat beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and oats, with added flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. May contain added vitamins and minerals.

name: Rice beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and brown rice, with added sweetener (such as agave syrup) and flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. Contains added calcium.

name: Soy beverage, flavoured
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans, with added sugar and flavourings such as cocoa powder and/or other flavours. Contains added calcium.

name: Soy beverage, flavoured, added vitamins and minerals
notes: A dairy milk substitute made from water and soy beans, with added sugar and flavour. Contains added vitamins A, B1, B2, B12 and calcium, phosphorus and magnesium.

name: Iced chocolate, made with dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing non-dairy beverage, vanilla ice cream and chocolate flavoured syrup, then topping with whipped cream.

name: Iced coffee, made with dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing non-dairy beverage, ice and cooled espresso coffee.

name: Milkshake, made with dairy milk alternative
notes: Beverage prepared by mixing non-dairy beverage, non-dairy ice confection and a flavoured syrup.

name: Meat alternative, legume &/or vegetable base, as purchased
notes: Meat alternative products made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Formed into burgers/patties.

name: Meat alternative, legume &/or vegetable base, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from chopped, minced, or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Formed into burgers/patties and cooked after purchase.

name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, mince/pieces/fillets, as purchased
notes: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) and other ingredients such as flavours and/or seasoning. Formed as pieces, fillets, strips and/or mince.

name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, mince/pieces/fillets, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) and other ingredients such as flavours and/or seasoning. Formed as pieces, fillets, strips and/or mince and cooked after purchase.

name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, schnitzels/fish alternative/patty/sausages, as purchased
notes: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) mixed with flour, and/or other vegetable proteins, breadcrumbs, flavours and/or seasoning. Formed into schnitzels, crumbed fish alternatives, patties and sausages.

name: Meat alternative, mycoprotein/fungus base, schnitzels/fish alternative/patty/sausages, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from a fungus base (mycoprotein) mixed with flour, and/or other vegetable proteins, breadcrumbs, flavours and/or seasoning. Formed into schnitzels, crumbed fish alternatives, patties and sausages and cooked after purchase.

name: Meat alternative, nut based, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from nuts (such as peanuts), with added vegetable protein, then cooked after purchase. Contains added iron, zinc and vitamin B12.

name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, as purchased
notes: Meat alternative products made from soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties.

name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties and cooked after purchase.

name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, added vitamins & minerals, as purchased
notes: Meat alternative products made from soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Contains added vitamins B3, B6, B12 and iron and zinc. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties.

name: Meat alternative, protein (soy/wheat/pea) base, added vitamins & minerals, cooked
notes: Meat alternative products made from soy, wheat and/or pea protein. Contains added vitamins B3, B6, B12 and iron and zinc. Formed into various shapes including strips, mince and patties and cooked after purchase.

name: Textured vegetable protein/soy granules, unprepared
notes: A defatted soy flour product derived as a by-product of  soybean oil extraction. Often used as a meat alternative or extender.

name: Tempeh (fermented soy beans), fried
notes: Soy beans fermented by Rhizopus oligosporus to produce a solid mass. Sliced and fried in sunflower oil, then drained of excess oil.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), skin
notes: Protein rich, soy-based food product, that forms on the surface of soy milk as it is heated. Purchased dried and packaged, then rehydrated upon preparation.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), firm, as purchased
notes: Commercially prepared soy bean extract, that has set to a firm texture. Ingredients include water, soy beans and firming agents.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), smoked, as purchased
notes: Commercially prepared soy bean extract, that has set to a firm texture and smoked. Ingredients include water, soy beans and firming agents.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), silken or soft, as purchased
notes: Commercially prepared soy bean extract, that has set to a soft, custard-like texture. Ingredients include water, soy beans and firming agents.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), flavoured, as purchased
notes: Commercially prepared soy bean extract, that has set to a firm texture. Ingredients include water, soy beans, firming agents and flavourings.

name: Tofu (soy bean curd), cooked
notes: Commercially prepared soy bean extract. Ingredients include water, soy beans and firming agents. Cooked with added oil.

name: Sausage, vegetarian style, as purchased
notes: Vegetarian style sausage made from chopped, minced or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Does not contain added vitamins or minerals.

name: Sausage, vegetarian style, added Fe, Zn and vitamin B12, as purchased
notes: Vegetarian style sausage made from chopped, minced or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. Contains added iron, zinc and vitamin B12.

name: Sausage, vegetarian style, cooked
notes: Vegetarian style sausage made from chopped, minced or blended vegetables and/or legumes and other ingredients such as spices, sugar and salt. May contain added iron, zinc and vitamin B12. Cooked by frying without added fat.

name: Meat alternative, bacon, cooked
notes: Vegetarian bacon rasher made from soy beans, peas, wheat gluten, starches, vegetable oil, thickeners, salt, sugar and flavours. Cooked with or without added fat.

name: Casserole, commercial, with tofu
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in casseroles, in a tomato based sauce. As prepared in restaurants, cafes and takeaway food outlets.

name: Casserole, homemade, with tofu
notes: Home prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in casseroles, in a tomato based sauce.

name: Curry, commercial, with tofu
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in curries, in a curry powder based sauce. As prepared in restaurants, cafes and takeaway food outlets.

name: Curry, homemade, with tofu
notes: Home prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in curries typically used in curries, in a curry paste based sauce.

name: Stir-fry, commercial, with tofu
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in stir-fries, in a sweet and/or spicy sauce (ingredients may include soy, oyster and sweet chilli sauces, and honey). As prepared in takeaway outlets, cafes and restaurants.

name: Stir-fry, homemade, with tofu
notes: Home prepared mixed dish containing tofu and vegetables typically used in stir-fries, in a sweet and/or spicy sauce (ingredients may include soy, oyster and sweet chilli sauces, and honey).

name: Stir-fry, commercial, with tofu & noodles
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing tofu, vegetables typically used in stir-fries and noodles, in a sweet and/or spicy sauce (ingredients may include soy, oyster and sweet chilli sauces, and honey). As prepared in takeaway outlets, cafes and restaurants.

name: Stir-fry, homemade, with tofu & noodles
notes: Home prepared mixed dish containing tofu, vegetables typically used in stir-fries and noodles, in a sweet and/or spicy sauce (ingredients may include soy, oyster and sweet chilli sauces, and honey).

name: Ready meal, plant based meat with rice/noodles
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing plant based meat alternatives with rice or noodles. Purchased frozen or refrigerated from supermarkets.

name: Ready meal, tofu with rice/noodles
notes: Commercially prepared mixed dish containing tofu with rice or noodles. Purchased frozen or refrigerated from supermarkets.

name: Soup, instant dry mix, all flavours
notes: Instant dry soup mix including ingredients such as starch, vegetable powders and pieces, salt and milk solids. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

name: Soup, instant dry mix, all flavours, reduced sodium
notes: Instant dry soup mix, including ingredients such as wheat noodles, vegetable powders and pieces, salt, sugar, starch, vegetable oil and herbs and spices. Formulated to be lower in sodium than regular dry soup powders. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

name: Soup, instant dry mix, all flavours, with pasta/noodles or crouton
notes: Instant dry soup mix with pasta/noodles or croutons. Ingredients include wheat flour, starch, milk solids, vegetable powders, meat powders and sugar. Requires mixing with boiling water before consumption.

name: Soup, made from dry mix, all flavours
notes: Soup prepared from an instant dry mix by the addition of water according to label instructions.

name: Soup, made from dry mix, all flavours, reduced sodium
notes: Soup prepared from a reduced sodium instant dry mix by the addition of water according to label instructions.

name: Soup, made from dry mix, all flavours, with pasta/noodles
notes: Soup with pasta/noodles or croutons prepared from an instant dry mix by the addition of water according to label instructions.

name: Soup, asian style, ready to eat, commercial
notes: Commercially canned or packaged soup commonly containing water, coconut milk, vegetables, konjac noodles, tofu, fish sauce, sugar, salt, colours and flavours. Soup does not require addition of any liquids and is heated gently before consumption.

name: Soup, bacon/ham & vegetable, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared soup made with bacon or ham, vegetables, seeded mustard and salt cooked in stock.

name: Soup, bacon/ham & vegetable, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with bacon or ham and vegetables cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, beef & vegetable, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared soup made with beef, vegetables, seeded mustard and salt cooked in stock.

name: Soup, beef & vegetable, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with beef and vegetables cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, beef & vegetable, with pasta or grains, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with beef and vegetables, with noodles, pasta or grains (such as rice, barley, couscous) cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, broth with meat & noodles
notes: Clear broth soup made with wheat or rice noodles, topped with cooked meat and vegetables. Pho and Laksa are examples of this food.

name: Soup, chicken, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared soup made with chicken, vegetables, seeded mustard and salt cooked in stock and cream.

name: Soup, chicken, ready to eat, canned
notes: Commercially canned or packaged chicken soup. Commonly contains stock, chicken, vegetables, cream, cornflour, salt, thickeners, preservatives and flavourings. Does not require dilution before consumption.

name: Soup, chicken & vegetable, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with chicken and vegetables cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, chicken & vegetable, with pasta or grains, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with chicken and vegetables, with noodles, pasta or grains (such as rice, barley, couscous) cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, crab & corn
notes: Soup made with crab, corn and other vegetables (such as ginger, garlic, spring onion), soy sauce, oil and egg cooked in stock.

name: Soup, cream of chicken, condensed, canned
notes: Commercially canned or packaged cream of chicken soup. Commonly contains chicken, wheat flour, skim milk powder, cream, vegetable fat, salt, sugar, onion, herbs, maize starch, water and natural colour. Requires dilution before consumption.

name: Soup, cream of vegetable, condensed, canned
notes: Commercially canned or packaged cream of vegetable soup. Commonly contains vegetables such as asparagus, mushroom and celery. Other ingredients include wheat flour, maize thickener, light cream or non-fat milk solids, salt, vegetable gum, spices and vegetable oil. Requires dilution before consumption.

name: Soup, cream of vegetable, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared soup made with vegetables (such as onion, broccoli, celery, mushroom, potato, garlic) and salt cooked in water with cream and/or milk.

name: Soup, cream of vegetable, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with vegetables (such as onion, broccoli, celery, mushroom, potato, garlic) cooked in water with cream and/or milk.

name: Soup, fish, commercial
notes: Commercially prepared soup made with fish and prawns, vegetables and salt, with noodles, pasta or grains (such as rice, barley, couscous) cooked in stock or water.

name: Soup, fish, homemade
notes: Home prepared soup made with fish, prawns and vegetables, with noodles, pasta or grains (such as rice, barley, couscous) cooked in stock or water.

name: Coconut, flesh, mature fruit
notes: Fresh flesh from inside a mature coconut, not preserved by drying or other techniques.

name: Coconut, grated & desiccated
notes: Grated or shredded flesh from inside a mature coconut that has been dried and packaged.

name: Coconut, toasted, salted
notes: Grated or shredded flesh from inside a mature coconut that has been toasted with added salt.

name: Coconut, cream
notes: Liquid extract of the flesh of a mature coconut, containing significant levels of fat so that it has a creamy appearance. Supplied canned or in UHT tetrapaks.

name: Coconut, cream, reduced fat
notes: Liquid extract of the flesh of a mature coconut, with a creamy appearance. Formulated to be lower in fat than regular coconut cream. Supplied canned or in UHT tetrapaks.

name: Coconut, milk, canned
notes: Canned liquid extract of the flesh of a mature coconut, generally with added water.

name: Coconut, milk, canned, reduced fat
notes: Canned liquid extract of the flesh of a mature coconut, generally with added water. Formulated to be lower in fat than regular coconut milks.

name: Coconut, milk, condensed, sweetened
notes: Canned milk prepared by adding sugar to regular fat coconut milk prior to evaporation of approximately 50% of the water content.

name: Coconut, milk, dried, powder
notes: Liquid extract of the flesh of a mature coconut, then dried to a produce a fine powder. Generally contains added starch or maltodextrin and milk proteins.

name: Coconut, water or juice
notes: The liquid portion from the inside of a mature coconut which may be filtered or pasteurised and packaged prior to sale.

name: Chestnut puree, added sugar
notes: Paste made with chestnuts, sugar, water and vanilla.

name: Lotus seed, paste
notes: Paste made from dried lotus seeds with sugar, water, oil and glucose syrup. Commonly used in Chinese-style desserts.

name: Nut, almond, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, almond meal

name: Nut, almond, roasted, unsalted
notes: Cream coloured, elongated nut with a brown skin that has been roasted with oil, without added salt.

name: Nut, almond, roasted, salted
notes: Cream coloured, elongated nut with a brown skin that has been roasted with oil and salted.

name: Nut, brazil, raw/natural, unsalted
notes: Raw, long, three sided, creamy coloured nut with a dark brown skin, enclosed in a tough, dull brown-grey shell, without added salt.

name: Nut, cashew, raw/natural, unsalted
notes: Raw, cream coloured, kidney shaped nut, without added salt.

name: Nut, cashew, roasted, unsalted
notes: Cream coloured, kidney shaped nut that has been roasted with oil, without added salt.

name: Nut, cashew, roasted, salted
notes: Cream coloured, kidney shaped nut that has been roasted with oil and salted.

name: Nut, cashew, roasted, coated in honey
notes: Cream coloured, kidney shaped nut that has been coated with a mix of sugar and honey and roasted.

name: Nut, cashew, roasted, savoury flavoured
notes: Cream coloured, kidney shaped nut that has been roasted, then flavoured with sugar and savoury spices.

name: Nut, chestnut, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, chestnut, roasted, unsalted

name: Nut, hazelnut, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, macadamia, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, macadamia, roasted, salted
notes: Cream coloured, smooth, spherical nut, with a very hard, smooth brown shell, covered with either a smooth or a slightly rough brown husk that has been roasted with oil and salted.

name: Nut, macadamia, roasted, coated in honey
notes: Light brown, smooth, spherical nut, with a very hard, smooth brown shell, covered with either a smooth or a slightly rough brown husk that has been coated with a mix of sugar and honey and roasted.

name: Nut, peanut, roasted, unsalted

name: Nut, peanut, roasted, salted
notes: Light brown, smooth, oval shaped nut, with a reddish-brown skin and a long, crisp, light brown shell containing two nuts. The skin has been removed and the nuts roasted with oil and salted.

name: Nut, peanut, roasted, coated in honey
notes: Light brown, smooth, oval shaped nut, with a reddish-brown skin and a long, crisp, light brown shell containing two nuts. The skin has been removed and the nuts coated in a mix of sugar and honey.

name: Nut, pecan, raw/natural, unsalted
notes: Raw, oval shaped nut with a thin, brown shell, sometimes with a black strip covered by a husk, without added salt.

name: Nut, pine, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, pistachio, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Nut, pistachio, roasted, salted

name: Nut, walnut, raw/natural, unsalted

name: Pandanus kernel

name: Seed, chia, cooked, unsalted

name: Seed, linseed or flaxseed

name: Seed, poppy

name: Seed, pumpkin, hulled & dried, unsalted

name: Seed, sesame, unsalted
notes: Raw, white, hulled sesame seeds, without added salt.

name: Seed, sunflower, unsalted

name: Seeds, mixed

name: Wattle seed (acacia), ground

name: Sugar, brown

name: Sugar, coconut
notes: A golden to light brown sugar derived from the sap of coconut palm flowers.

name: Sugar, palm
notes: A sugar derived from the sap of any variety of palm tree.

name: Sugar, raw
notes: A light brown sugar derived from the sap of sugar cane that has been boiled down until approximately 2% moisture remains. The syrup is poured into molds to form the characteristic larger crystals.

name: Sugar, raw, low GI (glucose index)
notes: Raw sugar which has been sprayed with molasses extract prior to packaging to increase resistance to digestion.

name: Sugar, white, fruit sugar (fructose), granulated or lump

name: Sugar, white, granulated or lump
notes: A white sugar derived from the sap of sugar cane that has been purified until it is almost entirely composed of sucrose. May be supplied in lumps, coarse or fine granules, or as a powder.

name: Sugar, white, icing
notes: A fine, white sugar produced by milling granulated cane sugar.

name: Sugar, white, icing mixture
notes: A fine, white sugar produced by milling granulated cane sugar, to which maize, tapioca or wheat starch is added.

name: Sugar, white, with added stevia, granulated
notes: A white sugar produced by mixing granulated cane sugar with the extract of the stevia plant to produce a sweetening product that is lower in energy than regular white sugar.

name: Sugar, with added intense sweeteners, reduced energy

name: Syrup, agave, light & dark
notes: A sweet, light to dark brown syrup produced from the leaves of the agave plant.

name: Syrup, golden
notes: A sweet, amber syrup produced from sugar, which has been partially broken down into glucose and fructose.

name: Syrup, date

name: Syrup, malt
notes: A sweet, brown syrup produced from sprouted barley.

name: Syrup, maple, pure (100% maple)

name: Syrup, maple flavoured

name: Syrup, maple flavoured, intense sweetened

name: Syrup, rice malt
notes: A sweet, brown syrup produced by steeping rice starch in enzymes to degrade the starches. The resultant liquid is then reduced until a syrup consistency is reached.

name: Treacle or molasses
notes: A sweet, highly viscous, dark brown syrup made during the refining of sugar.

name: Bean, paste, sweet

name: Jam, berry

name: Jam, fig

name: Jam, stone fruit

name: Jam, other fruit

name: Jam, all flavours, reduced sugar

name: Jam, all flavours, no added sugar (100% fruit)

name: Jam, all flavours, intense sweetened

name: Marmalade, ginger

name: Marmalade, all flavours, reduced sugar
notes: A fruit-based preserve with a chunkier consistency than jam, as both the skin and pulp of fruit is used in its making. Formulated to contain less sugar than regular marmalade.

name: Topping, all flavours, intense sweetened

name: Confectionery, jelly, prepared with coconut milk

name: Confectionery, licorice, chocolate-coated

name: Confectionery, nut, chocolate-coated

name: Confectionery, peanut brittle

name: Confectionery, rocky road

name: Confectionery, rum ball (rumball)

name: Confectionery, sultana, chocolate-coated

name: Confectionery, truffle

name: Confectionery, white Christmas, homemade

name: Confectionery, yoghurt, button

name: Ginger, crystallised

name: Halvah (Halva), plain

name: Honeycomb, plain

name: Jelly crystals, sugar sweetened, all flavours

name: Jelly crystals, reduced sugar, all flavours

name: Jelly crystals, intense sweetened, all flavours

name: Beef extract, bonox
notes: Thick, dark brown concentrated beef extract paste. Typically added to soups and stews for flavouring or to hot water as a beverage. Contains added salt.

name: Spread, yeast, vegemite
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folate.

name: Spread, yeast, vegemite, salt reduced
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added vitamins B1, B2, B3, B6, B12 and folate. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular vegemite.

name: Spread, yeast, vegemite, gluten free
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folate. Does not contain gluten.

name: Spread, yeast, cheesybite
notes: Thick, light brown, salty spread containing concentrated yeast extract (Vegemite) and cream cheese spread. Contains added salt, and vitamins B1, B2, B3 and folate.

name: Spread, yeast, marmite
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty concentrated yeast extract spread made by treating yeast with acid. Contains added salt, sugar, and vitamins B1, B2, B3, B12 and folate.

name: Spread, vegetable & yeast extract, mightymite
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty spread made from vegetable and yeast extracts. Contains added salt, sugar and vitamins B1, B2, B3, B12 and folate.

name: Spread, vegetable & yeast extract, Promite
notes: Thick, dark brown, salty spread made from vegetable and yeast extracts. Contains added salt and sugar.

name: Cardamom seed, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground seeds of Elettaria cardamomum, used as a spice.

name: Chilli (chili), dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground red pepper, characterised by a hot sensation when consumed as a spice.

name: Cinnamon, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground bark or quills of Cinnamomum verum, C. zeylanicum or C. aromaticum, used as a spice.

name: Cloves, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground, unopened flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum, used as a spice.

name: Coriander seed, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground fruit or seeds of Coriandrum sativum, used as a spice.

name: Cumin (cummin) seed, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground fruit or seeds of Cuminum cymimum, used as a spice.

name: Curry powder
notes: Dried and ground mixture of spices typically including cumin, coriander seed and turmeric.

name: Ginger, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground rhizome of Zingiber officinale, used as a spice.

name: Herbs, dried, all types
notes: Dried herbs including thyme, rosemary, oregano and sage, used to flavour various dishes.

name: Maca powder
notes: Dried and ground root of Lepidium Meyenii used as a food supplement.

name: Mustard powder
notes: Dried and ground yellow mustard seeds, for use in preparation of mustard paste or used as a spice.

name: Nutmeg, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground seed of Myristica fragrans (M. officinalis or M. aromatica), used as a spice.

name: Oregano, dried
notes: Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Oreganum vulgare, used as a culinary herb.

name: Paprika, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground fruit of red capsicums (sweet red peppers), used as a spice.

name: Pepper, black or white, ground
notes: Dried and ground unripe fruit of the pepper tree (Piper nigrum), used as a spice.

name: Rosemary, dried
notes: Dried, woody, fragrant needle-like green leaves of the Rosmarinus officinalis plant, used as a culinary herb.

name: Sage, dried
notes: Dried leaves of Salvia officinalis, used as a culinary herb.

name: Salt, table, non-iodised
notes: Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods. May contain free-flowing agents and small amounts of other minerals such as potassium.

name: Salt, table, iodised
notes: Fine granules of sodium chloride sold for direct addition to foods, to which iodine has been added in the form of potassium iodate or iodide. May contain free-flowing agents.

name: Salt substitute, potassium chloride
notes: Fine granules of predominantly potassium chloride for direct addition to foods. May contain sodium chloride and free-flowing agents. Products are sold as a substitution for regular table salt.

name: Seasoning, all purpose, dry powder
notes: Powdered seasoning mix intended for addition to meat, vegetables and savoury mixed dishes. Major ingredients include salt, rice flour, sugar and spices.

name: Seasoning mix, chilli based, for tacos
notes: Powdered seasoning mix intended for addition to meat and other ingredients to prepare Mexican-style dishes such as taco filling. Major ingredients include maize flour, sugar, salt and spices.

name: Spices, dried, all types (except chilli & paprika)
notes: Ground spices including ginger, cumin, coriander seeds, cloves, cardamom, cinnamon and nutmeg used to flavour various dishes.

name: Thyme, dried
notes: Dried, and sometimes ground, leaves of Thymus vulgaris, used as a culinary herb.

name: Turmeric, dried, ground
notes: Dried and ground rhizome of Curcuma domestica or C. longa, used as a spice.

name: Stock, dry powder or cube
notes: Concentrated meat stock that is dried and supplied as a powder or compressed into a cube. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

name: Stock, dry powder or cube, reduced salt
notes: Concentrated stock that is dried and supplied as a powder or compressed into a cube. Formulated to be lower in salt than regular stock powder or cubes. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

name: Stock, liquid, all flavours, prepared
notes: Savoury liquid prepared by diluting commercial stock powder or cubes with water. Can be consumed alone, or used as an ingredient to flavour recipes. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

name: Stock, liquid, all flavours, reduced salt, prepared
notes: Savoury liquid prepared by diluting reduced salt commercial stock powder or cubes with water. Can be consumed alone, or used as an ingredient to flavour recipes. Contains ingredients such as salt and flavours.

name: Stock, liquid, all flavours, homemade
notes: Homemade savoury liquid prepared by simmering meat or bones, herbs, spices and vegetables in water, and then straining.

name: Baking powder, dry powder
notes: Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes. Composed of 50% cream of tartar, 25% baking soda, and 25% starch.

name: Baking soda (bicarbonate), dry powder
notes: Fine white powder used to chemically leaven baked goods such as cakes. Also referred to as sodium bicarbonate.

name: Cream of tartar, dry powder
notes: Purified, crystallised potassium bitartrate, used as the acid component of some fast acting baking powder mixtures.

name: Essence, all types (except vanilla)
notes: All solutions used as a flavouring agent. Does not include vanilla.

name: Gelatine, all types
notes: Unflavoured light yellow granular proteinaceous powder. Used to sweeten and thicken soups, sauces and desserts.

name: Gluten, from wheat (vital wheat gluten)
notes: Protein rich extract of wheat flour. Used to increase the protein content in food, and to increase the integrity and elasticity of bread dough.

name: Lecithin, soy, granules
notes: Phospholipid-rich granular extract of soy beans, often used in baking and as an emulsifier, as purchased from supermarkets for domestic use.

name: Pectin, unsweetened, dry powder
notes: Fine white or pale yellow powder derived from fruit. Used as a thickening agent in food, and to give jelly-like consistency to jams and marmalades. Nutrient data may differ in commercial preparations.

name: Starch, potato
notes: Fine powder composed of polysaccharides derived from the potato tuber. Commonly used as a thickening agent in foods.

name: Vanilla, artificial
notes: Solution containing water and flavours, used as a substitute for vanilla extract as a flavouring agent.

name: Yeast, bakers, compressed
notes: A cream or pale grey paste with a fine, smooth texture. Active raising agent used to leaven a wide range of breads, cakes and pastries.

name: Yeast, dry powder
notes: A cream or pale grey powder with a fine, smooth texture. Active raising agent used domestically to leaven a wide range of breads, cakes and pastries.

name: Infant snack, bar, fruit based
